summary: Completion gains stop_reason: StopReason{Stop,Length,ToolUse,Refusal} (default Stop), set by every wire once text, calls and refusal are known. Length stops keep the generated content instead of erroring: Chat finish_reason=length (stream and JSON), Responses response.incomplete / status=incomplete with incomplete_details.reason=max_output_tokens (stream, JSON and routed strict paths; uncompleted function_call items are dropped), Anthropic stop_reason max_tokens / model_context_window_exceeded, Gemini finishReason MAX_TOKENS (empty parts allowed). Tool calls cut by the limit are reported, not rejected (Chat/Anthropic partial arguments become {}; malformed input without a length stop is still an error). core.rs never dispatches calls from a Length completion: each gets a LimitExceeded error tool result 'output token limit reached; this tool call was cut off and was not executed...' (same path as over-budget calls, arguments kept) and the loop continues to the next request.
